name: Averfo
author: averfo

sections.description:
A privacy-first, cookie-free analytics platform that helps you understand your data quickly with AI-powered reports that actually make sense.

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on an external third-party service, Averfo, to function correctly and requires an active subscription to function.

The plugin sends website usage metrics (such as page views, referrers and anonymised location data) from your WordPress site to Averfo’s servers so that analytics and AI-generated reports can be provided.

An active Averfo account is required to use this plugin.

Averfo: https://averfo.com
Terms and Conditions: https://averfo.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://averfo.com/privacy-policy

Tired of cookie banners?

It’s time to get rid of Google Analytics and focus on privacy for your customers. Averfo doesn’t gather cookies, ip addresses or cross-site fingerprinting, meaning GDPR compliance and no annoying cookie popups.

Metrics that make sense

Feel like you need a degree to use other analytics platforms? Averfo is designed to have relevant metrics you need all in one page. Watch realtime visitors, page views, sources, locations, devices, and custom events/funnels.

AI reporting straight to your inbox

Short on time? Let our weekly and monthly reports do the work for you. Get a simple, digestible overview of your site’s performance, with privacy-first, GDPR-compliant reporting and AI-powered insights that surface pages and funnels needing attention.

By using this plugin, you acknowledge that data collected by the plugin is transmitted to Averfo in accordance with their Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.

How to get started

  • Sign up for Averfo. (Averfo is free for 14 days, after which you can choose a plan based on your monthly views.
  • Install the plugin onto your WordPress website and you are integrated.

Get Help

Contact us at support@averfo.com for general questions or help.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the averfo plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Check back on the Averfo website dashboard later for website analytics to start working.
